tools.name: GetLayers AI
tools.description: Library of cinematic 3D website prompts and layouts for Claude / AI coders. Includes ready-to-use Three.js/React source code and an Obsidian vault to train AI agents.
tools.bestFor: Building responsive 3D interactive websites in minutes with Claude.

tools.name: Scrolltide
tools.description: Provides 600+ 3D design prompts with full source code to give websites a futuristic, interactive 3D feel.
tools.bestFor: Hero 3D animations, interactive 3D graphics, and immersive landing pages.

tools.name: Coconut UI
tools.description: 100+ ready-to-go animated cards, transitions, and interactive components ready to copy and paste directly into Claude / ChatGPT prompts.
tools.bestFor: Rapid UI prototyping with AI without writing CSS/animation code from scratch.

tools.name: Backlit UI (Bklit UI)
tools.description: UI component library tailored for dark-mode SaaS dashboards, featuring fully animated charts, metrics bars, and status displays.
tools.bestFor: Building modern SaaS analytics dashboards with animated charts.

tools.name: Anime.js
tools.description: Lightweight JavaScript animation engine allowing you to pull thousands of complex animations and SVG effects from a single library.
tools.bestFor: Micro-interactions, complex SVG morphing, CSS property animations, and timeline sequencing.

tools.name: Motion.dev
tools.description: Modern animation and transition engine for web & React (successor to Framer Motion for web) packed with buttery-smooth physics-based animations.
tools.bestFor: Page transitions, spring physics, scroll animations, layout morphing, and gesture interactions.

tools.name: Navbar Gallery
tools.description: Extensive curated library of navigation bar inspirations (static, dropdown, mega menu, sidebar) so designs don't look like generic templates.
tools.bestFor: Designing unique, premium header and navigation components.

tools.name: Superhero
tools.description: Comprehensive library of landing page hero sections featuring 3D motion, typography, and layout concepts.
tools.bestFor: Building impactful first folds that immediately capture visitor attention.

tools.name: CTA Gallery
tools.description: Curated collection of call-to-action designs (buttons, modals, floating triggers, newsletter signups) crafted to drive user clicks.
tools.bestFor: Designing high-converting buttons, lead generation sections, and interactive CTAs.

tools.name: Footer Design
tools.description: Showcase of high-end, aesthetic, and typographic footer layouts.
tools.bestFor: Making website footers look clean, premium, and functional rather than an afterthought.

tools.name: Refero Styles
tools.category: Product UI Design Systems & Aesthetic Benchmarking
tools.description: Real design styles, layouts, and typography patterns sourced directly from leading tech products and startups.
tools.bestFor: Selecting color schemes, font pairings, and design systems with proven real-world aesthetic value.

tools.name: 3D Icons
tools.description: Collection of 1,400+ beautifully crafted open-source 3D icons available in multiple angles and colorways (Figma, PNG, GLTF).
tools.bestFor: Replacing flat vector icons with modern 3D graphics to give UI a polished, trendy look.

tools.name: Manus AI
tools.category: Autonomous Agentic AI Design & Web Builder
tools.description: General-purpose agentic AI system that autonomously creates professional-grade UI designs, dashboards, and entire websites end-to-end.
tools.bestFor: Fully autonomous creation of dashboards, slides, and websites without manual coding.
